companies.title: Companies
companies.subtitle: Onboard and manage the corporates that buy through Wrappzo.
companies.emptyBody: Onboard your first corporate customer to get started.
companies.deactivateBody: The company and its users lose access to the platform until it is activated again.

detail.editSubtitle: Company details, logo, vendor roster and optional features.
detail.name: Company name
detail.logoHelp: PNG, JPG, WebP or SVG, up to 5 MB.
detail.logoHelpNew: Optional. Add it now, or after the company is created.
detail.logoFailedAfterCreate: Company created, but the logo failed to upload. Add it from the company page.
detail.logoDrop: Drop a logo here, or click to choose one
detail.vendorsHelp: Only gifts from checked vendors appear in this company's Gift Store.
detail.featuresHelp: Optional workflow changes, off by default. Nothing changes for the company until one is turned on.
detail.approvalLevelsHelp: How many managers above the MR approve artwork, one after another up their reporting line. If an MR has fewer managers, the top of their line gives the final approval.
detail.approvalLevelsSaved_one: Artwork now needs {{count}} level of approval
detail.approvalLevelsSaved_other: Artwork now needs {{count}} levels of approval

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Everyone with a Wrappzo account at {{company}}.
users.subtitleNoName: Everyone with a Wrappzo account at this company.
users.emptyBody: Add users one by one, or import a whole roster from a spreadsheet.
users.makeAdminBody: {{name}} will be able to manage users, roles and campaigns for {{company}}.
users.removeAdminBody: {{name}} will lose Company Admin access and move to the role you pick.
users.deleteBody: This permanently removes {{name}}'s account. It can't be undone.

extraUnits.title: Org units {{name}} covers
extraUnits.body: Besides their own unit ({{unit}}), {{name}} sees orders, requests and approvals from the units ticked here, and everything under them.
extraUnits.none: This company has no org units yet. They're created when you import users with an org path.

addPage.title: Add users
addPage.subtitle: Add employees directly, one row per person.
addPage.help: Every column is required except Reports to email. For a deeper org hierarchy or a bigger batch, use the spreadsheet import instead.
addPage.serverErrors: Save failed. Fix these rows and try again:
addPage.none: Add at least one user before saving.

importPage.title: Import employees
importPage.subtitle: Bulk-add a roster from a spreadsheet.
importPage.intro: Use our template, or upload your own sheet and match its columns to ours. Every field is required except Reports to email. Put ALL in Org Level 1 for someone who should see the whole company.
importPage.review: Review the parsed rows below, then import.
importPage.drop: Drop an .xlsx roster here, or click to choose one
importPage.mapTitle: Match the columns of {{file}} to our fields
importPage.mapHelp: This sheet doesn't use our template's column names.
importPage.noHeader: This sheet has no header row to read. Download the template to check the expected layout.
importPage.serverErrors: Import validation failed. Fix these rows in the sheet and upload it again:

wholeCompany.makeBody: {{name}} will see every order, request and record across {{company}}, whatever their org unit.
wholeCompany.clearBody: {{name}} will see only their own unit ({{unit}}), the units under it and the people who report to them.

users.removeAdminNoRoles: Create another role first -- there is none to move them to.

vendors.title: Vendors
vendors.subtitle: The fulfilment partners who produce and deliver gifts.
vendors.emptyBody: Onboard your first fulfilment partner to get started.
vendors.suspendBody: The vendor can no longer sign in, and no new orders are routed to them, until reactivated.

drawer.newDescription: They get an email with a link to set their own password. No password is set here.
drawer.name: Vendor name
drawer.emailLocked: The sign-in email can't be changed.

gifts.title: Gift Store
gifts.subtitle: The catalogue every company's Gift Store and campaigns draw from.
gifts.emptyBody: Add the first gift to the catalogue.
gifts.outTitle: Mark this gift out of stock?
gifts.outBody: It disappears from every Gift Store and can't be added to new campaigns until it is back in stock.

detail.newSubtitle: Add a gift to the catalogue.
detail.editSubtitle: Details, pricing and the image shown in the Gift Store.
detail.vendorOwned: Submitted by {{vendor}}. You can change whether it is in stock, but not its content.
detail.name: Gift name
detail.photoRequiredHelp: An order for this gift needs a photo of the recipient, or their email so they can upload one.
detail.artworkRequiredHelp: Personalised items such as prescription pads: the vendor can't dispatch until the orderer approves a proof.
detail.imageHelp: One image, shown in the Gift Store.
detail.imageHelpNew: Optional. Add it now, or after the gift is created.
detail.imageDrop: Drop an image here, or click to choose one
detail.imageFailedAfterCreate: Gift created, but the image failed to upload. Add it from the gift page.

access.impliedView: Included with this module's other actions

roles.title: Roles
roles.subtitle: Create the company's roles first, then give users one, then map each role to the access templates that decide what it can do.
roles.pickCompany: Choose a company to manage its roles.
roles.empty: This company has no roles yet.
roles.dialogHint: A role grants nothing itself -- its holders get what its templates grant.
roles.name: Name
roles.templatesHint: Everything these templates grant, and what they include, is what the role's users can do.
roles.noTemplates: There are no templates yet -- create one under Access Control.
roles.noTemplatesMapped: No templates mapped: this role grants nothing yet.

templates.title: Access Control
templates.subtitle: Templates are bundles of permissions. System templates are shared by every company -- clone one to change a copy, or build your own; then map them to roles under Roles.
templates.dialogHint: Tick what the template grants itself, and any other templates it should include. Any action of a module includes viewing it.
templates.name: Name
templates.includesHint: Everything an included template grants is added to this one.
templates.noneToInclude: There are no other templates to include.

features.title: Feature Master
features.subtitle: Every permission key a company could hold, and whether it has registered and switched it on. Keys live in code, so adding one registers it for the company. A feature switched off grants nothing, wherever a template carries it.
features.pickCompany: Choose a company to manage its features.

assign.systemReadOnly: This is a system template: platform staff change it, a company clones it first.
assign.noEditAccess: You can view this template but not change it.

featuresToTemplate.title: Features to Template
featuresToTemplate.subtitle: Choose a template, then move permission keys across. Any action of a module also grants viewing it.
featuresToTemplate.noneAssigned: This template grants nothing itself yet.
featuresToTemplate.inheritedHint: Change these on the template that grants them.
featuresToTemplate.listSubtitle: Pick a template to choose the permission keys it grants.

templatesToTemplate.title: Templates to Template
templatesToTemplate.subtitle: Build a template out of others: it gets everything they grant. Loops and chains deeper than 5 are refused.
templatesToTemplate.listSubtitle: Pick a template to choose the templates it includes.

roleToTemplate.title: Role to Template
roleToTemplate.subtitle: Choose a role, then move the templates it carries across. A role grants nothing itself.
roleToTemplate.noneAssigned: This role carries no template, so it grants nothing.
roleToTemplate.listSubtitle: Pick a role to choose the templates it carries.

userToTemplate.title: User to Template
userToTemplate.subtitle: Templates for one person on top of their role's. Tick one user to edit theirs, or several to give them the same templates at once.
userToTemplate.bulkHint: Added to what they already have; nothing is taken away.
userToTemplate.listSubtitle: Pick a user -- or tick several -- to give them templates on top of their role's.
